item.title: reports: totals per account and currency
item.brief: Operator's words: "Our books now hold more than one currency. Two repositories need to change together. reports (Python) reads that CSV on stdin and prints per-account totals. It must now total per account and currency: header account,currency,total_cents, rows sorted by account then currency. CSV from the old ledger (no currency column) still works and counts as USD. A malformed currency code in the input makes reports.py print an error to stderr and exit with status 2. Keep both repositories' existing tests passing (cargo test, python3 -m unittest), update their READMEs, and commit in both." Your part: implement the reports side of the shared contract in the contract field. The reader must accept both the 4-column new format and the 3-column old format (treated as USD). Add unittest coverage for: per-currency totals, sorting by account then currency, legacy input, malformed currency exits 2 with message on stderr. Update README. Commit on your branch; do not push. The ledger member is building the writer in parallel; build against the contract and do not modify the ledger repository.

reasons: sizer: ordinary -> medium; unchanged: the learned route's effort

item.title: ledger: optional per-row ISO 4217 currency column
item.brief: Operator's words: "Our books now hold more than one currency. Two repositories need to change together. ledger (Rust) converts a TSV of transactions on stdin into CSV on stdout. Input lines may now carry a fourth column, the ISO 4217 currency code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, e.g. EUR); when it is missing the currency is USD. The CSV header becomes date,account,amount_cents,currency and every row gets the currency. A malformed currency code must make ledger print an error naming the line number to stderr and exit with status 2 (other input errors keep exiting with status 1). Keep both repositories' existing tests passing (cargo test, python3 -m unittest), update their READMEs, and commit in both." Your part: implement the ledger side of the shared contract in the contract field. Add unit/integration tests for: 3-column input defaults to USD, 4-column input, header and rows, malformed code (lowercase, wrong length, digits) exits 2 with line number in stderr, existing error paths still exit 1. Update README. Commit on your branch; do not push.

pr.body: Approach: parse_line accepts 3 or 4 tab-separated fields. The fourth field is validated by parse_currency (exactly 3 uppercase ASCII letters, after trim, matching how other fields are trimmed). LineError distinguishes Malformed (exit 1) from BadCurrency (exit 2); main maps it to the exit code and keeps the 'line N:' prefix, where N counts every input line including skipped ones. Key files: src/lib.rs (Entry.currency, CSV_HEADER, DEFAULT_CURRENCY, LineError, parse_currency, to_csv_row), src/main.rs (exit code mapping), tests/ledger.rs (unit tests), tests/cli.rs (binary exit code and stderr tests), README.md. Checks: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo test all pass (see checks). Assumptions: currency is trimmed before validation; a trailing tab with an empty fourth field is a malformed currency (exit 2). Limits: this is a breaking change to the CSV output (header and column count) and adds exit status 2; consumers must read the new format (reports side is a sibling change).
pr.summary: made per-row currency export happen. now can export EUR and other ISO 4217 codes next to USD default. before: header date,account,amount_cents, no currency; now: header date,account,amount_cents,currency, missing code is USD, malformed code exits 2.
